prompt: RFC 1035 resolver SLIST address no history round trip time
answer: For an address in the RFC 1035 resolver’s SLIST with no history, use an expected round-trip time of **5–10 seconds as the worst case**, with lower estimates for addresses on the same local network. History is maintained per server address (and may be specific to the resolver-address/server-address pair).
